mission: SSC V1.0.1 SVOS G2 ONE-SHOT HISTORICAL REPLAY V2
blocker_summary: The canonical historical H1 bias path session_sweep_continuation.h1_bias.resolve_h1_market_bias requires a HistoricalSymbolMetadataManifest with authority OWNER_APPROVED_DATASET_MANIFEST bound to the exact H1 dataset file being replayed. DEV_002's combined H1 CSV (data/research/ssc_fresh_dev/SSC_V1_0_1_G2_DEV_002/raw/EURUSD_H1.csv) has NO such manifest. The only owner-approved EURUSD H1 symbol-metadata manifest (config/historical_datasets/EURUSD_H1_symbol_metadata.yaml) is scoped to the D:\ raw file (fingerprint sha256:f1b456e4...) and fails DATASET_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH against the DEV_002 H1 file (sha256:93d27d8c...). Executing the replay would therefore require either (a) fabricating an OWNER_APPROVED_DATASET_MANIFEST without owner sign-off, or (b) stretching an existing manifest beyond its documented per-file scope -- both are governance violations and are refused.

gate_results.G4_strategy_authority: PASS_STRATEGY (canonical run_replay, v1.0.1, OPPOSITE_SESSION_BOUNDARY) -- but H1 metadata authorization for DEV_002 is ABSENT
gate_results.G6_execute_replay: BLOCKED (missing owner-approved H1 symbol-metadata manifest for DEV_002 H1)

remediation_required: Provision a NEW owner-approved symbol-metadata manifest for the DEV_002 H1 CSV (dataset_id e.g. EURUSD_H1_SSC_G2_DEV_002, dataset_fingerprint sha256:93d27d8cbeb85c0b595ece7d18a43ac66219ae9fbb137e23a9826b84fc191c79, tick_size 0.00001, authority OWNER_APPROVED_DATASET_MANIFEST, scope HISTORICAL_ANALYSIS_ONLY), mirroring the existing precedent config/historical_datasets/EURUSD_H1_WARMUP_PLUS_GEN002_symbol_metadata.yaml (which required an explicit owner decision recorded in-session). This requires explicit owner authorization and must be done in a dedicated, separately-authorized mission -- it is NOT within this replay mission's authority.
next_single_action: Owner-authorized mission to provision the DEV_002 H1 symbol-metadata manifest; only then may a fresh one-shot G2 replay mission execute G6.
